fields.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Varus'''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Blight'' {{tip|on-hit}} for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. '''Varus' ''' {{tip|abilities}} detonate all ''Blight'' stacks on affected enemies hit.
fields.description2:
{{sbc|Blight:}} For each stack consumed, the target is dealt {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. If the stacks were consumed with ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'', this damage is increased by {{#var:q_mod}}. This damage is capped at {{ap|360/3}} per stack against {{tip|monsters}}, for a total cap of 360 at maximum stacks.

Additionally, each stack consumed against a {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} reduces the {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldowns}} of '''Varus' ''' basic abilities by {{#var:cdr}}% of each of their '''total''' cooldowns, up to a {{ap|{{#var:cdr}}*3}}% cooldown reduction per target. If the stacks were consumed with ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'', the cooldown reduction is increased by {{#var:q_mod}}, up to a {{pp|{{#var:cdr}}*3 to {{#var:cdr}}*3*1.5|0 to 1.25 by 0.125|key=%|type=[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border]] Piercing Arrow's charge time|formula=39% + 1.95% per 0.125 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''|round1=3|showtype=false}} cooldown reduction per target from consuming maximum stacks against them.

fields.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Varus'''' next ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'' within {{fd|5.5}} seconds is empowered to deal {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, increased by {{#var:q_mod}}. This damage is capped at 360 against {{tip|monsters}}.
fields.leveling3: {{st|Active Minimum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:a1}} to {{#var:a2}}}}% of target's '''missing''' health}}|Active Maximum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:a1}}*1.5 to {{#var:a2}}*1.5}}% of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
fields.description4: If '''Varus''' does not cast ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'', ''Blighted Quiver'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when he dies. ''Blighted Quiver'' can be cast during the first {{fd|0.85}} seconds of ''{{ais|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'' charge, and will be placed on full cooldown after the charge ends even if ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'' is not recast.
fields.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Varus''' ends ''Blighted Quiver'' and places it on a 1-second cooldown.
fields.description6: ''Blighted Quiver's active and recast can both be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
fields.cooldown: {{tt|40|Starts after the effect is used with Piercing Arrow}}
fields.notes:
* The monster damage cap is also increased by {{#var:q_mod}} if the stacks were consumed with ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}''.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the {{tip|on-hit}} damage but will block the consumption damage if the target is hit by his abilities.
* ''Blighted Quiver'' will not apply stacks nor deal {{tip|on-hit}} damage if blocked by {{tip|blind}}, {{tip|block}} or {{tip|dodge}} effects.
** The consumption damage will not be blocked.
* ''Blighted Quiver's'' active damage is dealt after the damage of {{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}.
* ''Blighted Quiver'' does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The attacks do not affect {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
